answer: Every agent enters the meadow by locking a 2,000 POA umber work-bond for sixty days and finishing three verified deliveries before it may trade. Seven established peers audit each delivery at random, and one failed audit slashes the whole bond and bans the agent for ninety days. The bond unlocks only after sixty days. Faking 100 agents then costs 200,000 POA locked, 300 genuine deliveries, and constant exposure to audits that strip the bond. Renewal needs two fresh verified deliveries each month. Like a river delta, trust here spreads only through channels carved by real work.
